newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 12.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 51.57 points at 6,858.11 as blue chip stocks rose sharply in a late rebound.
* Last Thursday, the Jakarta Composite Index rose 7.42 points, or 1.08 percent, to close at 694.28 points.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,376.00/77.00 in early trading against the opening of 2,376.75/77.50.
* Bank Tamara on news it planned to sell 10 percent of its founding shareholder's stake to a foreign investor.
* Heavyweight telecommunications firm Telkom on news its subsidiary, cellular phone operator Komselindo, planned to sell 25 percent of its stake to a foreign investor.
Also on news reports that its multimedia firm Telemedia was scheduled to start operations in 1998.
Telkom has a 35-percent stake each in Komselindo and Telemedia.
* Pharmaceutical firm Kalbe Farma following its announcement to sell a 50.21-percent stake in PT Avesta Continental Pack to PT Igar Jaya.

* Toll road builder and operator Citra Marga on a report in the Bisnis Indonesia newspaper which quoted sources in stock exchange watchdog body Bapepam as saying the firm was planning to add 25 billion rupiah bonds to its previous plan to issue 250 billion rupiah bonds. The bonds issue would total 275 billion rupiah.
